title: Ex-NFL QB on Joe Burrow's Bengals future: 'I think he wants to leave'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Ex-NFL QB on Joe Burrow's Bengals future: 'I think he wants to leave'
sources.description: Joe Burrow's future in Cincinnati is based on winning this season, Russell Wilson says. If not, the quarterback could have a new home come 2027.
